records.title: Literacy and Numeracy in Select Countries in the Caribbean
records.methodology: Analysis of nine Caribbean education systems, literature survey, questionnaires and interviews with education officers
records.findings: Reviews the status of literacy and numeracy in Barbados, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, St Kitts and Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines, and Trinidad and Tobago.
records.citation: de Amorim, A. C. A. (2008). Literacy and numeracy in select Caribbean countries. The University of the West Indies repository (UWISpace).

records.title: Literacy and Numeracy in the Caribbean: Report of the Caribbean Subregional Meeting
records.methodology: Regional policy dialogue report with commissioned papers
records.findings: Report of the 2–3 December 2008 meeting in Bridgetown, including a chapter on Trinidad and Tobago's experience of international reading literacy assessment.
records.limitations: Conference report; findings vary by chapter.
records.citation: Inter-American Development Bank & Caribbean Development Bank. (2008). Literacy and numeracy in the Caribbean: Report of the Caribbean subregional meeting, December 2–3, 2008, Bridgetown, Barbados. Regional Policy Dialogue on Education.

records.title: PISA 2022 Results (Volume I and II) — Country Notes: Jamaica
records.findings: Half of Jamaican students reached at least Level 2 in reading (OECD average 74%); 1% reached Level 5 or above (OECD 7%); girls outperformed boys in reading by 35 score points.
records.indicators: Share of students by reading proficiency level; gender gap
records.limitations: Student response rates were substantially below PISA technical standards, so bias cannot be excluded.
records.citation: OECD. (2023). PISA 2022 results (Volume I and II) – Country notes: Jamaica. OECD Publishing.

records.title: PIRLS 2016 Encyclopedia: Trinidad and Tobago — Reading Instruction in the Primary Grades
records.methodology: National education system profile prepared for the IEA PIRLS 2016 Encyclopedia
records.findings: Describes the 2013 primary curriculum, the use of literacy coaches from 2014 to 2016, and that classroom teachers are responsible for reading instruction throughout primary school.
records.citation: International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement. (2017). PIRLS 2016 encyclopedia: Trinidad and Tobago. TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center.

records.title: A Description and Evaluation of Adult Basic Literacy Education (ABLE) Provision in Barbados: Individual, Institutional and National Goals, 1990–1993
records.methodology: Doctoral study describing and evaluating adult basic literacy provision
records.findings: Examines adult basic literacy provision in Barbados against individual, institutional and national goals between 1990 and 1993.
records.limitations: Historical; reflects provision in the early 1990s.
records.citation: Best, E. V. (1993). A description and evaluation of Adult Basic Literacy Education (ABLE) provision in Barbados: Individual, institutional and national goals 1990–1993 [Doctoral dissertation, Institute of Education, University of London]. UCL Discovery.
